short_description: MAXTRAX is the lightweight, easy-to-use vehicle recovery and extraction device that's easily carried by almost anything with four-wheels ensuring an easy way out if your vehicle becomes stuck.
long_description: MAXTRAX takes the drama out of getting stuck. The aggressive large cleats on MAXTRAX sink their teeth into the tyre tread and the terrain under your 4WD vehicle to prevent it from slipping back into mud, snow, or sand and make vehicle recovery quick and easy. MAXTRAX is the perfect fit for every outing. Measuring just 1150mm long X 330mm wide x 85mm tall (45 inches long X 13 inches wide), each set of MAXTRAX stacks together at a height of just 85mm (3.5 inches). MAXTRAX stows easily with the rest of your car camping, overlanding, or four-wheel drive touring gear. Made of UV-stabilized, flexible, super tough engineering-grade reinforced nylon, MAXTRAX provides traction and a firm base to get your vehicle quickly back on track. They have been tested at the University of Queensland to wrap completely around a 33-inch tire without breaking. Each MAXTRAX weighs just 3.4 kilograms (7.5 pounds). MAXTRAX is easy to carry and thanks to it's signature double-edged design, it's easy and quick to manoeuvre under your tires. MAXTRAX have six comfortable built-in handles and a shovel at either end for removing excess earth to help get you unstuck quicker. They also have exclusive keyhole accessory points to allow you to securely mount your MAXTRAX.

gold_guarantee_content: Standard Rack Guarantee — Fit confidence, always free. Our Standard Rack Guarantee comes automatically with every roof rack purchase. It ensures your rack fits your vehicle and performs as it should — giving you confidence from day one. Gold Rack Guarantee — Book fitting, get total confidence. When you book your roof racks to be professionally fitted at Roof Racks Galore, you're automatically covered by our Gold Rack Guarantee — the most comprehensive protection for your gear and your journey. Gold Rack Guarantee includes: Professional Installation — enjoy complete confidence with a professional fit by our experienced Fit Technicians; with over 30 stores across Australia and New Zealand, we ensure your setup is correct, secure and safe for the long haul, whether you're carrying bikes, boxes, awnings or kayaks. Rack Check — Yearly Peace of Mind — a full safety check at time of install, plus Annual Rack Health Checks in Year 2 and Year 3, so you can travel with peace of mind, year after year. Key Cover — 3 Years of Nationwide Support — lost your rack keys on the road? Your Gold Guarantee includes Key Cover for 3 years, with up to 2 replacement keys per year. Free Basic Accessory Fitting — when your racks are fitted by us, we'll also fit your eligible accessories for free: roof boxes, roof-mounted bike racks, cargo baskets, kayak carriers, fishing rod holders, ski carriers, platform accessories (eye bolts, load stops, shovel holders, jerry can holders). Rooftop tents, awnings, ladder slide systems and other technical accessories are excluded; all items must be on the same invoice and fitted at the same time as the roof racks. 90-Day Exchanges and Hassle-Free Returns — covered for up to 90 days to exchange your racks if they're not the perfect fit for your needs, at any of our locations across Australia and New Zealand. Nationwide Support, Expert Advice — with over 30 stores across Australia and New Zealand, our team is here to help every step of the way. Note: Fitting charges apply and will be confirmed in-store before installation.
shipping_info_content: Shipping & Delivery Information. At Roof Racks Galore, we are proud to be Australia's only nationwide roof rack specialists, with over 30 stores across all major Australian cities. Thanks to our extensive network of Distribution Centres located in key states — Queensland, Western Australia, Victoria, New South Wales, South Australia, and the Australian Capital Territory — we offer the fastest and most reliable delivery service in the industry. Why Choose Roof Racks Galore? Unmatched Nationwide Coverage — our investment in local Distribution Centres means we can rapidly move stock across Australia. Fast & Reliable Delivery — we deliver efficiently both through our store network for Click & Collect / Click & Fit and to couriers for home deliveries; many metro-area orders arrive next business day. Comprehensive Inventory — from small fitting kits to large bulky items like roof boxes and platforms, we have the stock on hand. Dedicated Delivery Fleet — our own fleet of vehicles moves stock from our Distribution Centres to all our stores every day. Exceptional Customer Service — our dedicated national customer service team will update you every step of the way. Shipping Cost Rules: use our shipping estimator on the product page or during checkout to determine applicable freight costs; we recommend shipping to a business address for the fastest delivery. Estimated Delivery Times: Metro QLD, NSW, VIC, SA, WA — Next Business Day to 3 Business Days. Regional QLD, NSW, VIC, WA and all of TAS — 3-5 Business Days. Northern Territory — 5-7 Business Days. Large/Bulky Goods — 5-7 Business Days. (Estimates are provided by our couriers and delays may occur; no deliveries on Saturdays, Sundays or public holidays.) No retailer or courier company can ever 'guarantee' a next working day delivery, though we work with some of the best couriers in the business. Contact Us: Email help@roofracksgalore.com.au, Phone 1300 071 264, or visit the Nearest Store Locator.
